sahneler.metin: Early one morning, a wildfire ignited near Paradise, California.
Within hours the town was mostly destroyed, and eighty five people died.
Hardware on a power transmission line had failed.
Strong winds drove the fire into town.
More than eighteen thousand structures were destroyed.
The utility pleaded guilty to eighty four counts of manslaughter.
The century-old line needed manual effort to switch off.

aciklama:
Camp Fire destroyed the town of Paradise, California. The cause: a worn line component failing in strong winds and igniting dry vegetation.
